fields.hero_h1: Glass Repair and Replacement in Toronto and the GTA
fields.hero_subhead: Residential, commercial, and emergency glass services across the GTA. We are repair-first, police-cleared, and out the same or next day.
fields.overview_heading: Glass repair done right, across the GTA
fields.overview_body: SolidGuard provides glass repair and glass replacement for homes and businesses across Toronto and the GTA. From a cracked window pane to a storefront or an after-hours emergency, our glass repair services start with an assessment: we repair where we can, so you are not paying for a replacement you do not need. Police-cleared technicians, fair pricing, and a workmanship warranty on every job.

faqs.question: What kind of glass work does SolidGuard do?
faqs.answer: Residential window and door glass, commercial storefronts and partitions, and emergency board-up and repair across the GTA.

faqs.question: Do you repair or replace?
faqs.answer: We are repair-first. If the glass or frame can be saved we repair it, which is faster and cheaper. When replacement is the right call, we tell you straight.

faqs.question: How fast can you come out?
faqs.answer: Same or next day for most jobs, and after-hours for emergencies across most of the GTA.
